changedDescriptions.name: cloud_io_admission_control_policy
changedDescriptions.newDescription: Selects the admission policy used by cloud_io::admission_control. 'passthrough' disables admission control (client pool is the only constraint). 'reservation' introduces reserved-slot admission control, configurable across a fixed set of groups: producer_upload, consumer_fetch, and default_group.

changedDescriptions.name: cloud_io_admission_control_reservation
changedDescriptions.newDescription: Per-group target_reserved values for the reservation_policy admission control. Each entry has the form 'group_name:slots' (e.g. 'producer_upload:2'). The policy keeps each group's reservation lane sized to this target while the group is active; idle reservations past the dwell window are reclaimed back to the common pool. Entries with an unrecognized group name are rejected when the property is set. Only consulted when cloud_io_admission_control_policy=reservation.

changedDescriptions.name: cloud_topics_compaction_disabled
changedDescriptions.newDescription: When true, completely disables compaction of cloud topics.

changedDescriptions.name: cloud_topics_l1_reader_cache_eviction_timeout_ms
changedDescriptions.newDescription: Time after which idle L1 readers are evicted from the per-shard reader cache.

changedDescriptions.name: cloud_topics_l1_reader_cache_max_size
changedDescriptions.newDescription: Maximum number of L1 readers cached per shard. When the cache exceeds this limit, the oldest idle reader is evicted.

changedDescriptions.name: cloud_topics_l1_streaming_read_chunk_size
changedDescriptions.newDescription: Maximum number of object-storage bytes that a cache-bypassing L1 streaming read (used by leveling and compaction) buffers in memory at once before serving them to the reader. Bounds both peak per-read memory and how much of an object is downloaded under a single held cloud storage client connection.

changedDescriptions.name: cloud_topics_leveling_disabled
changedDescriptions.newDescription: When true, completely disables leveling of cloud topics.

changedDescriptions.name: cloud_topics_leveling_interval_ms
changedDescriptions.newDescription: How often to scan managed cloud-topic partitions for leveling work (rewrites of runs of undersized L1 objects).

changedDescriptions.name: cloud_topics_leveling_max_range_bytes
changedDescriptions.newDescription: Maximum total bytes per leveling job (one contiguous run of undersized extents). Runs exceeding this are split into multiple jobs so that each job's rewrite and metastore commit stays bounded in time and blast radius. Lower values mean more, smaller jobs.

changedDescriptions.name: cloud_topics_leveling_min_extent_size_ratio
changedDescriptions.newDescription: An L1 extent shorter than this ratio of cloud_topics_reconciliation_max_object_size is considered undersized and eligible for leveling.

changedDescriptions.name: cloud_topics_max_concurrent_leveling_jobs_per_shard
changedDescriptions.newDescription: Maximum number of leveling jobs that may run concurrently on a single shard. Live-adjustable.

changedDescriptions.name: cloud_topics_metastore_block_cache_size
changedDescriptions.newDescription: Size in bytes of the per-database uncompressed-block cache used by the L1 metastore LSM database. Only takes effect when an LSM database is opened (broker restart or metastore partition leadership transfer).

changedDescriptions.name: cloud_topics_metastore_max_pre_open_fibers
changedDescriptions.newDescription: If non-zero, the number of fibers used to pre-open every SST file in the L1 metastore LSM database at open time (broker restart or partition leadership transfer), populating caches before the first read. Set to 0 to open SSTs lazily.

changedDescriptions.name: cloud_topics_metastore_retry_timeout_ms
changedDescriptions.newDescription: Overall deadline for retrying an L1 metastore operation on transport errors. To allow more than one attempt, keep this larger than cloud_topics_metastore_rpc_timeout_ms.

changedDescriptions.name: cloud_topics_metastore_rpc_timeout_ms
changedDescriptions.newDescription: Timeout for a single L1 metastore RPC to the metastore partition leader. Bounds one attempt; the overall operation may retry until cloud_topics_metastore_retry_timeout_ms elapses.

changedDescriptions.name: cloud_topics_metastore_sst_chunk_size
changedDescriptions.newDescription: Size of the byte ranges used to read metastore LSM SST files from object storage into the local cache. Reads hydrate only the chunks they cover, and a read spanning several uncached chunks fetches them in parallel. Smaller chunks reduce read and cache amplification for point reads; larger chunks reduce request count for scans. Changing the value invalidates previously cached chunks.

changedDescriptions.name: cloud_topics_metastore_write_buffer_size
changedDescriptions.newDescription: Size in bytes of the memtable for the L1 metastore LSM database. Also parameterizes per-level target SST file sizes (each level is sized proportionally to this value). Only takes effect when an LSM database is opened (broker restart or metastore partition leadership transfer).

changedDescriptions.name: code_hugepages_enabled
changedDescriptions.newDescription: Map the binary into hugepages

changedDescriptions.name: features_auto_enable
changedDescriptions.oldDescription: Whether new feature flags auto-activate after upgrades (true) or must wait for manual activation via the Admin API (false).
changedDescriptions.newDescription: Whether features whose `available_policy` is `always` or `new_clusters_only` are auto-activated by the controller after the cluster active logical version reaches their required version. When false, the cluster active version still advances normally, but each such feature must be activated explicitly via the Admin API. Does not affect features with `available_policy::explicit_only`, which always require explicit activation.

changedDescriptions.name: health_monitor_metrics_enabled
changedDescriptions.newDescription: Whether the cluster_health_* metrics are exported. When enabled, each broker refreshes them on an interval of 10x `health_monitor_max_metadata_age`, so the two scale together. Refreshing increases CPU usage and network traffic. Disabled by default.

changedDescriptions.name: kafka_fetch_read_coalescing_enabled
changedDescriptions.newDescription: Coalesce concurrent fetches of the same partition offset into one read and serialization shared across the requesting consumers, reducing duplicate reads and fetch-response memory under high fanout.

changedDescriptions.name: kafka_handler_latency_all
changedDescriptions.newDescription: Enable latency histograms for all Kafka API handlers. When disabled, only important handlers (produce, fetch, metadata, api_versions, offset_commit) have latency histograms.

changedDescriptions.name: kafka_per_entity_quota_metrics
changedDescriptions.newDescription: Enable per-entity labels on quota throttle time and throughput metrics. Metric series are registered only when an entity is actively being throttled and deregistered after the quota GC window. Opt-in due to cardinality and performance implications.

changedDescriptions.name: schema_registry_enable_qualified_subjects
changedDescriptions.oldDescription: Enable parsing of qualified subject syntax (:.context:subject). When false, subjects are treated literally, as subjects in the default context. When true, qualified syntax is parsed to extract context and subject.
changedDescriptions.newDescription: Enable parsing of qualified subject syntax (:.context:subject). When true, qualified syntax is parsed to extract context and subject. When false, subjects are treated literally, as subjects in the default context.

changedDescriptions.name: schema_registry_sync_memory_bytes
changedDescriptions.newDescription: Maximum bytes of schema bodies held in memory at once while a schema registry cluster link reconciles from the source.

changedDescriptions.name: schema_registry_sync_parallelism
changedDescriptions.newDescription: Maximum number of schemas imported concurrently while a schema registry cluster link reconciles from the source.

changedDescriptions.name: schema_registry_use_rpc
changedDescriptions.newDescription: Use internal Redpanda RPCs for schema registry internal topic I/O. When disabled, use a Kafka client for schema registry internal topic I/O instead.

changedDescriptions.name: shadow_link_failover_batch_size
changedDescriptions.newDescription: Maximum number of mirror topics to include in a single batched failover controller command.

removedDeprecatedProperties.name: log_eviction_exempt_topics
removedDeprecatedProperties.description: A list of topics in the kafka namespace whose local log is exempt from any form of data deletion: retention settings, local retention for topics with Tiered Storage enabled, and disk space management never remove their data from local disk, and partition moves always deliver the full log to the new replica. Does not affect topic deletion via the Kafka API (see kafka_nodelete_topics).

removedDeprecatedProperties.name: schema_registry_deferred_recovery
removedDeprecatedProperties.description: Defer schema compilation during Schema Registry startup, then compile the loaded schemas in parallel across cores. If disabled, every replayed record is compiled sequentially during the replay.

removedDeprecatedProperties.name: schema_registry_replay_on_startup
removedDeprecatedProperties.description: Replay the internal `_schemas` topic into the store at Schema Registry start-up instead of lazily on the first request. Makes recovery time predictable and keeps the first request from blocking behind a full replay.
